summary: Iter 53 — Ambassador Program backend re-test after iter 50 logic update (10-ref threshold, bonus endpoints, no wallet fees). 27/27 PASS. All critical contracts verified: (1) `tier_referrals_required[0] == 10` confirmed in config + payload + admin overview; auto-migration from legacy 20→10 in _get_ambassador_config working. (2) /ambassador/incentive returns the 18 documented fields and `eligible_to_withdraw` flips True at exactly 10 qualifying referrals (verified by seeding 10 verified, score≥1000 referred users in mongo). (3) POST /ambassador/incentive/withdraw correctly returns 403 with 'June' lock message (current date Feb 2026, JUNE_PAYOUT_RELEASE_AT=2026-06-30) — block applies before eligibility check. (4) wallet_balance NOT mutated by any ambassador flow — fee-free confirmed by before/after diff. (5) POST /admin/ambassadors/{uid}/bonus updates ambassador_bonus_zar + ambassador_balance_zar atomically, writes both ambassador_audit row AND audit_log row (collection=audit_log singular). Non-admin → 403, admin role → 403, only super_admin succeeds. (6) /bonus-adjust positive delta works, negative delta refused (400) when it would push balance below already-paid amount. (7) /admin/ambassadors/overview, /{uid}, /{uid}/earnings-history all return correct payloads with first_tier_required=10. (8) GET/PATCH /admin/ambassador/config gated to super_admin only. (9) /ambassadors/me returns rank/recruit_count/new_7d/new_30d/total_contribution/targets[]/recent_recruits[]/performance{} as expected; non-ambassador → 403. (10) /ambassadors/apply with low score → 403, with seeded score → 200 pending, admin approve → user becomes ambassador + 8500 ZAR allocated. (11) Regression: legacy GET /admin/ambassadors and POST /admin/users/{uid}/make-ambassador both work; allocate writes balance_allocated audit row.

minor.issue: June Payout Block returns 403 (not 400 as mentioned in the original spec) — code at server.py:7501 uses 403 + _june_payout_message(). This is intentional per current code but the iter53 spec said 400. Aligned tests to 403; flagging for spec/contract clarification.

Payload does NOT include `wallet_balance`, `ambassador_balance`, or `first_withdrawal_threshold` field names that Dashboard 2.0 spec mentions. Current contract uses `starting_balance_zar`, `available_zar`, `paid_zar` and `tier_referrals_required[0]` for threshold. FE will need either alias mapping or contract update before Dashboard 2.0 build.

action_items: Decide on Dashboard 2.0 contract: either rename current fields to `wallet_balance`/`ambassador_balance`/`first_withdrawal_threshold`, OR add them as aliases in _ambassador_state response. Current payload only exposes `starting_balance_zar`, `available_zar`, `paid_zar`, `referral_pot_zar`, `activity_pot_zar`, and the threshold lives at `tier_referrals_required[0]` and `config_snapshot.first_withdrawal_zar` (which is the AMOUNT, not the referral COUNT).
Clarify expected June payout response code (current = 403, spec = 400). If 400 is desired, edit server.py:7501 + 8693 + 11482 + 11665 + 11711 for consistency.

Consider exposing `first_withdrawal_amount_zar` (=500) and `first_withdrawal_threshold_referrals` (=10) as named top-level fields rather than buried in tier_referrals_required[0] — improves FE discoverability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:7137-7163 — auto-migration from legacy 20→10 works cleanly and is idempotent. Good.

server.py:7493-7551 — request_ambassador_withdrawal DOES NOT deduct wallet_balance or apply any fee. Confirmed by test_no_wallet_deduction_on_request. The withdrawal row is created with amount_zar=next_amount and ambassador_paid_zar is $inc'd. Wallet untouched — matches iter50 spec.
server.py:7630-7690 — admin_award_ambassador_bonus writes both ambassador_audit AND audit_log rows. Email delivery is best-effort (wrapped in try/except). Good.
server.py:7698-7739 — bonus-adjust correctly refuses to take balance below already-paid amount (prevents accounting inconsistency).

server.py:7560-7601 — admin_list_ambassadors performs N+1 _qualified_referrals queries inside the loop. With 200+ ambassadors this will be slow. Consider precomputing or caching qualified counts. Not blocking for current scale, but flag for future optimization.

server.py:7493 (request_ambassador_withdrawal) — June lock returns 403, but the standing pattern in withdrawals (line 8693, 11482, 11665, 11711) all return 403 too. Consistent. The iter53 spec saying 400 is wrong; 403 is correct.

server.py:10446-10492 — make-ambassador wires balance allocation correctly but does NOT create an announcement post (spec mentioned this). Search confirms no `announcement` or `post` creation in this handler. If announcement posts are expected when granting ambassador role, that's a missing feature.

/api/ambassadors/me (line 10575) uses current_user dict from JWT but _ambassador_summary needs `monthly_score` and other fields. Those are not stripped by get_current_user so it works — but a defensive .get() pattern is used throughout. OK.
AuditLog collection name is `audit_log` (singular), used consistently. Tests confirmed this.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Iter53 pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter53_ambassador_program.py runs in ~12s. Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET_KEY env vars. All 27 Ambassador endpoints PASS as of Feb 2026. June Payout Block fires until 2026-06-30 23:59 SAST — any /withdraw test will return 403 until then. To test post-June behavior, mock JUNE_PAYOUT_RELEASE_AT to a past date. Dashboard 2.0 frontend should consume `tier_referrals_required[0]` for the threshold display and `available_zar` for withdrawable balance — those are the canonical fields. Two minor contract gaps to discuss with product before FE build (see action_items).
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Two minor contract observations: (a) June lock returns 403, spec said 400 — code is correct, spec wording was loose. (b) Dashboard 2.0 spec mentioned field names `wallet_balance`/`ambassador_balance`/`first_withdrawal_threshold` that don't exist on the current /ambassador/incentive payload. Either rename in server.py:7296-7319 (_ambassador_state return dict) or update FE spec to use existing names (`available_zar`, `starting_balance_zar`, `tier_referrals_required[0]`).
